circuit.name: merkle16rc
circuit.statement: merkle16 with a private 64-bit amount in the leaf: public root, nullifierHash, context; nullifierHash == MiMC(nullifier), leaf == MiMC(nullifier, trapdoor, amount), 0 <= amount < 2^64 (std/rangecheck: one BSB22 commitment), the path from leaf hashes to root (MiMC(left, right) per level)

notes.linOpening: ClaimedValues[0] of gnark's proof struct (opening of the linearised polynomial at zeta); not part of the 768-byte proof, the verifier recomputes it (verify.mjs cross-checks it equals r0)
notes.proofs: gnark's prover blinds with crypto/rand, so re-running gives different (equally valid) proofs
notes.tampered: expect is the reference verdict; gnark is gnark's own Verify on the same tampered struct, or n/a for byte-level encodings gnark's structs cannot hold
